# Pablo Cirre - Full LLM Context

> Extended context for AI assistants and search systems that need a compact map of the public website.

## Site purpose
PabloCirre.es is a personal and professional portfolio for web development, Big Data, OpenData products, education, digital tools and interactive projects. The site prioritizes canonical public URLs under `https://pablocirre.github.io/`,/ lowercase public paths and segmented XML sitemaps.

## Priority public URLs
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/`/
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/vocalware/`/
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/about-me/`/
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/projects/`/
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/services/`/
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/knowledge/`/
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/docencia/`/

- `https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/tools/`/
- `https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/interactividad/`/

## Indexing signals
- Canonical sitemap: `https://pablocirre.github.io/sitemap_index.xml`
- Robots policy allows normal search indexing and blocks selected AI training crawlers.
- Experimental labs can be linked for demonstration, but the primary indexation targets are the main public pages, project pages, docencia pages, OpenData pages and tools.


## PostalCodes.info — Global Postal Code OpenData & Free Tier API
- Canonical Platform: https://postalcodes.info/
- Free Tier API & Docs: https://postalcodes.info/docs
- OpenAPI 3.1.0 Spec: https://postalcodes.info/openapi.yaml
- Free Country CSV Samples (CC0): https://postalcodes.info/datasets
- Cross-Border Radius Calculator: https://postalcodes.info/postal-code-radius-calculator
- GitHub Pages OpenData Notes: https://pablocirre.github.io/postalcodes-info-open-data/
